validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="idle">
  <state id="idle">
    <transition event="start" target="running"/>
    <transition event="start" target="failed"/>
    <transition event="error" target="failed"/>
  </state>
  <state id="running">
    <transition target="done"/>
    <transition target="running"/>
  </state>
  <final id="failed"/>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: transition on `start` in `idle` can never be selected

secondary.message: this earlier transition has no `cond` and always matches first

notes: within one state the interpreter selects the first enabled transition in document order; every event it matches is matched first by an earlier unconditional transition
diagnostics.help: both transitions match the same events, so reordering would only shadow the other one: add a `cond` to the one that should be taken only sometimes, or remove this one

diagnostics.message: eventless transition in `running` can never be selected

secondary.message: this earlier transition has no `cond` and always matches first

notes: within one state the interpreter selects the first enabled transition in document order; an earlier eventless transition without `cond` is always enabled
diagnostics.help: both transitions match the same events, so reordering would only shadow the other one: add a `cond` to the one that should be taken only sometimes, or remove this one
